title: 8 Signs You're Chasing a Wife Instead of Chasing God
caption:
The guy desperate for a wife reeks of it, and she can tell. The guy walking with God becomes the guy worth marrying. Here's how to tell which one you actually are right now, even if you'd never say it out loud.

The order matters more than the outcome.

#faith #singleness #godlyman #christianman #relationships
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
